primary_auth.quote: All apps (public and private) should manage authentication and authorization using OAuth 2.0.

access.quote: Your app is live and can be shared with any company in Pipedrive via its direct, unlisted installation link.

mcp.quote: Pipedrive launches native MCP server, bringing CRM workflows directly into AI assistants

verdict.reason: Public OAuth2 docs, free developer sandbox account on request, and unlisted private apps can connect other companies without marketplace review.

primary_auth.quote: Server-side flow - the preferred way of authenticating for web apps (one of four OAuth 2 flows)

access.quote: Free plan ... API Integrations | 1000 calls per hour

mcp.quote: The server is live at https://mcp.podio.com - just point your AI platform at it and log in with your Podio account.

verdict.reason: Free plan includes API access and anyone can register an app to get an OAuth2 client ID/secret.

primary_auth.quote: Developers of Marketplace apps must obtain a global OAuth client from Zendesk

access.quote: you will need to request a sponsored account and wait for approval from Zendesk ... Zendesk will typically review your request within 1 week.

mcp.quote: Zendesk now runs a first-party MCP server, and it lives on your own subdomain ... https://<your-subdomain>.zendesk.com/api/mcp

verdict.reason: Well-documented API, but multi-tenant OAuth needs a Zendesk-approved global OAuth client from a sponsored d3v- account (otherwise per-customer OAuth client setup).

access.quote: Plain Pricing - Plans from $35/seat/month | 7-Day Free Trial

mcp.quote: The Plain MCP server at https://mcp.plain.com/mcp lets tools like Claude, ChatGPT, and Cursor work with your support data directly.

verdict.reason: Public GraphQL API with workspace API keys, but no free tier (7-day trial then paid) and each customer must create an API key.

primary_auth.quote: Use your API key as the username and your API key secret as the password.

mcp.quote: Twilio MCP server (Public Beta, docs search/retrieve); Twilio Labs also publishes github.com/twilio-labs/mcp exposing Twilio APIs as MCP tools

verdict.reason: Excellent public docs and instant no-card credentials, but trial expires after 30 days and continued use requires pay-as-you-go funding.
